balls.text: taken by midwicket running back. Slower ball across off stump at a length. Looks for the slog, is deceived and ends up slicing that. Samad runs to his left, stretches his hands out and holds on. That is not easy to do
short at off stump, pulled off the top edge to deep backward square
full and into leg stump, steps out and flicks to deep midwicket's left. Shakib comes back for the sacrificial second run and for his efforts, is rewarded with a sloppy throw
makes him bowl the wide. Shapes for the ramp and then stops. Bhuvi gets a legcutter out after looking at that and DK leaves it alone
shuffles and shovels this to deep midwicket's right, didn't quite get this away from the stumps
over the keeper. Short slower ball just outside off, he's stuck swinging under it with a pull, but the top edge gets him the runs
shuffles and swipes it over deep backward square! Stunning hit. Shuffles and jumps into this full ball outside off. On one knee and sweet timing on the swipe
wide yorker outside off and once again he can't get the sweep away, trickles out to deep midwicket
forced out of the blockhole and over the bowler. Smart from Karthik. Got deep in the crease and really brought the bottom hand into play to scoop this out
yorker outside off, can only drive it along the ground to sweeper
yorker Nattu hitting the spot again. Just outside off stump and past the bat as he looks to jam this towards third man
full and wide outside off, gets low for the sweep but that angle has made it hard. Ends up along the floor to long-on
full and into leg stump, driven down to long-on
full and down leg side, can't get bat on it
length on leg stump, watchfully pushed through midwicket
short of a length and outside off, mistimed cut towards long-off

taken at deep backward square! Intelligent grab there from Samad, who had to take a few steps backward and to his left. Length ball slanted into leg stump, got the sweep out but not a lot of elevation on that. Samad takes it with a well timed jump and a reverse cup

taken at long-off. Afghan spin pulling KKR back here. Slow, length, just outside off. Rana has cleared the front leg to swing into the leg side. Ends up slicing an easy one for long-off. A good innings from Rana, looked tired by the end though and tapered off a little
looks like a wristy release. Full and wide outside off, driven on the bounce to extra cover
short of a length at off stump, punched straight to extra cover off the back foot
length at middle stump, leans in and flicks through midwicket
googly, short of a length outside off, pulled along the ground to deep midwicket
good length and ripping sharply into the body to catch him on the thigh guard as he looks to glance this
length at middle stump, swept straight to short fine

Pandey holds low to his right. Expertly done, as always. Rashid was kept for Russell, and he has the stick on him yet again. This was full and it was drilled hard and flat to long-on's left. Pandey ended up over-running it, but his eyes tracked it all the way and he managed to twist to go to his right and hold on after a decent amount of sprinting to his left
oh this looks close. But they won't review. Googly, not picked, stabbing well in front of the body and struck in front of leg stump
googly slides down leg side. Pitched on leg and kept going. No chance for Saha. Russell was looking to defend that
yorker length at the stumps, flicked out to deep square
beaten by the yorker. This one slanted across the corridor and Russell misses on the slog
four straight away! A yorker but just a tad down leg side. Stands tall and tickles that fine
full and just outside off, sliced out to deep backward point

held on the second attempt. Natarajan gets Tripathi with a slower ball. Cuts away from a leg stump line. He's down for the slog sweep but that ends up a slice off the low part of the bat. Floats to Saha's left and behind him. It pops out of the gloves as he turns but he's alert to where it's headed and holds on
length and into middle stump, slogged off the inside half, along the floor to deep midwicket's left

thick outside edge runs away between backward point and short third man. That is an impressive fifty for Tripathi. This is a legcutter, full outside off. Looks for the drive and is done by the deviation, but the runs come anyway
nails the yorker and forces him to jam this back to him
short of a length outside off, a slower ball, but this is crafty from Tripathi. Waits on it and slices that between keeper and short third
massive! That is pummeled over square leg. Length ball angled into his body and he clears the front foot and nails this slog
slower ball at a length outside off, pulled out to deep midwicket
oh, smoked! What wonderful bat speed this guy has. Length ball at the stumps, keeps the front leg in the leg side to make room and nails this square drive to beat sweeper cover to the right
legcutter at a length outside off, pulled between deep midwicket and long-on for an easy two
short of a length and wide outside off, steps out and closes the face on this flat-batted shot. Ends up at long-on
beaten on the reverse sweep. Good length across off stump, and just a little late on it
low full toss easily swept over deep square. He's swept him a couple of times tonight. Expected the full length and fetched this from outside off
length and cramping him as he makes room. Chopped towards backward point
legcutter at a length on leg stump, nudged wide of deep square with soft hands
googly at a length on leg stump, gets his reverse sweep straight to backward point
sweetly timed cover drive at this full ball but extra cover gets a hand on it to deflect towards long-off
a touch too full outside off and Tripathi gets under that to drill it over the bowler's head. Intended to hit it there and did it well
googly, short of a length and stays low as he hurriedly pulls. Thick inside edge to deep square's right
good length and following him down leg side as he tries to drive through the off side, inside edge onto pad and trickles past the keepre's right leg
short of a length legbreak outside off, stays in the crease and jabs it to short third
quick yorker at off stump, jammed out to sweeper cover
length and tight at the stumps, looks to heave into the leg side but can't get it past midwicket
length outside off, steps out to drive into the off side but that skids on straight to take the thick inside edge
slog sweep to deep midwicket's left! Sweet sound off the bat. Nabi slowed it down and turned it away marginally from middle stump, but he reached out and got a lovely swing through this
short of a length outside off, punched to sweeper cover
swept to the long leg boundary. Length ball at leg stump, quickly down on a knee and perfectly placed
ruins a good over with a expertly executed shot. This is back of a length and at off stump. He shuffles and drops his weight into the off side before lofting this short-arm pull over fine leg
follows him and nails the yorker down leg side. Rana has backed a long way away but can only push this back to the bowler
yorker at middle stump, hurriedly stabbed towards midwicket on the edge of the circle
full and at the stumps, backs away and stabs it to extra cover
short of a length, just outside off with a slant inwards. Slower ball too. Opens the face to steer that to third man
slower length ball at leg stump, clipped through vacant square leg
fifty for Rana with a six! Dropped short at leg stump, lines it up, swivels and nails this pull shot in deep backward square's direction
short of a length at off stump, punched to sweeper cover
short of a length outside off, 122kph, slashed on the rise to sweeper cover
a cutter in the corridor, at a good length. Shuffles to expose the stumps and stabs this to deep square
swiped to the long leg boundary. Short and sticking in the surface. Gets a little steep on him as he walks down, but he gets the pull away, off the top edge
short of a length and just outside off, chopped on the rise to sweeper cover
Shankar flies to his right at long-on and saves two. It's a length ball swept firmly from the stumps to his right, but he sprints a long way to parry this for Abdul Samad at deep midwicket
chopped from close to the stumps. Made room and exposed the stumps as this went across him, but that pitches and rips in quickly. Just about gets bat to find short third
full and fired in at the stumps, gets a stride out and drills it aerially to long-on's left
inside edge onto pad as he lunges forward to push this googly through the covers
googly, at a length and outside off. Gets on the back foot and punches to long-on
lbw given as he misses the reverse sweep on a full toss. Sounded like bat. Rana reviews right away. It's at a middle stump line, but yes, it has come off the inside edge and onto his boot
jumps past the outside edge. Dipping length ball outside off, turns in and he opens the face to try and stab that into the off side. He's caught inside the line
short of a length outside off, waits for that to skid on, opens the face and gets that fine of short third
drilled far over long-off! Tossed right up, drifting away from off stump. Gets on one knee and clubs it with full control
short of a length outside off, punched through cover
length ball wide outside off, leans in and slices aerially through cover
good length and into leg stump, leans in and flicked to deep midwicket

Enter Rashid. Exit Gill. There's the breakthrough for SRH. Wrong'un from Rashid, on a length and breaking in. Gill goes for a roundhouse swipe, loses his balance, misses the sweep altogether. Rashid nails off stump
back of a length and outside off, sticks in the Chepauk pitch, chipped down to long-on
back of a length and fizzing back in to ping the pad, but this seems to be sliding down leg
darted on a back of a length, legbreak that spins in and cramps the batsman for room, defensively dropped to the leg side. Saha swoops down on the ball
kicks up from a back of a length and outside off, 96.1ks, chopped off the back foot to the right of backward point for an urgent single
fast and flat outside off, shovelled away over midwicket
skidder on a heavy length outside off, chopped to the covers. KKR are 50 for 0 after the powerplay
short and sliding on outside off, Gill leans back and forces it to extra-cover
glided away behind point
Rana aims for a reverse-sweep, Nabi finds some extra bounce and hits him on the glove
on a length and heading down the leg side, Rana sizes it up and sweeps it away fine enough for four
flat and speared into the leg stump, defended
Rana shimmies out, meets a wide full-toss, and pushes it up to mid-off
on a length and holds its line outside off, hacked across the line off the inner half. Dragged over mid-on
on a length and on off, not quite sure if that was a slower ball, doesn't quite come on. Rana squirts it out as the ball rolls behind to the keeper
there's the Natarajan yorker, bending into leg stump, jammed out
back of a length and running away outside off, guided square through point
lofted over mid-on for six. More aggressive intent from Gill. Full on middle, right in the swinging arc, Gill clears his front leg and dismisses it over Natarajan's head
nurdled to midwicket
back of a length on middle, Gill gives himself some swinging room, shimmies out and smears it to extra-cover
down the track, Raina yorks himself and squirts it out to mid-off
Rana follows power with cheek. On a length and outside off, Rana shuffles across off and shovels it over square leg
Rana ventures down the track this time, Sandeep drags his length back outside off. Rana frees his arms again, flaying it between point and cover, this time along the ground
full and attached with width outside off, Rana is happy to stay leg-side of this ball and pumps it over extra-cover. Slices this knuckle ball over the infield
fullish and outside off, no real movement in the air or off the seam, but the ball isn't quite coming on - clear signs of a slow, dry, black-soil pitch. Check-driven to the covers
full and around off, tap and run to mid-off
on a length and around off, chopped to point

chipped in the air and Rana gets away with it. On a length and just a shade outside off, sticks in the pitch, probably the slower variation. Rana is early into a drive and spoons in the air. Samad doesn't quite attack the ball from mid-on. He is late to pick it up and run in, by the time the ball bounces in front of him
full on the stumps, punched straighter to mid-on for one
Bhuvneshwar pitches it up, searches for swing, but this white ball is travelling in rather straight lines. So, it's easier for Gill to drive it away between midwicket and mid-on with the wrists

crunched wide of mid-off. That is typical Rana. Loves swinging through the line and rarely misses out on overpitched deliveries. There is width on this too to free the arms and that is a full-blooded drive
good length and just outside off, opens the face and runs that to backward point
inside edge trickles away to the boundary. Good length and across the corridor. Steps out and swings across the line but can't get that off the middle
full and just outside off, sweetly punched with a big stride, to the left of mid-off
good length outside off, steps out and punches on the up into the covers
appeal for lbw turned down as Rana is caught in half stride in front of middle stump. A good length ball that's certainly not going over, but has probably pitched outside leg
good length and just outside off, tentative as he pats this into the covers
full and just outside off, decent stride as he blocks on the front foot
beaten. Good length and going across the corridor. Feet rooted again for Rana as he swishes inside the line of this
good length and tight at middle and leg, 134.9kph, patted watchfully to mid-on
full and searching for swing that isn't there first up. It's an overpitched ball and Rana reaches out with his hands and caresses this between extra cover and mid-off
six to finish, but that won't affect the result, only reduce the margin. Shorter and this time Pandey was ready for it, rocked back and pulled it over deep midwicket.
full toss on off, has a big thrash at it, but it squirts from the outside edge to trickle to cover
yorker on the fourth stump, drilled to long-on. Still can't find the gaps, Pandey
and now he bowled it into the batsman, who can only hoick it to short fine leg
and this one is bowled into the pitch and going away from Samad, he wants to crash it through cover, gets a little under edge to the keeper. If he hadn't touched it, would have been wide
nails the yorker on the fifth stump, sticking to the round the wicket line, dug out to long-off. No timing on it which works in the batsman's favour because they sprint two
bouncer to end, and a very good one too. Quick, sharp and outside off, Pandey has to fetch the pull from over his shoulder and he can't even connect.
down the track to mess with his length but Cummins kept this back of, and Samad is cramped for room, pulls it to deep square leg

boom. What a hit. Cummins went for another yorker, misses the length by just a teeny bit, and Samad, drills it straight back over the bowler, weight on back foot and wrists showing unbelievable power.
goes for the yorker on middle and leg, Samad goes deep and whips it off his toes through midwicket
wallopped. What a hit, first ball. Samad has arrived. Too short outside off, he calmly goes on the back foot and unleashes on that one with a pull over deep midwicket
good pick up pull shot to a back of a length ball, but once again Pandey can't get the placement right and it bounces down to deep square leg

caught at cover. Dre has really got that angle from around the wicket working for him, and Shankar couldn't quite get properly underneath this as he tried to go over long-off. Ends up with a leading edge that loops up for a simple catch.
wonderful bowling. Nails a yorker that ends up on the sixth stump, with the angle from around the wicket making it really difficult to hit. Shankar swings and misses
carved over cover. Moves across, anticipating a wide outside off ball, so gets in reach of it and gets it over cover. There's protection in the deep though
nails the wide yorker this time and Pandey can only drive it to long-off
and Dre goes too far outside off, from around the wicket, misses the tramline so he'll have to rebowl that
drilled back past the bowler, but the field placing is perfect. Long-on is very straight and Shankar has moved across to thump it straight past the bowler, but the fielder is in place

low full toss on the stumps, opens his stance and swings hard at it, makes great connection too, but the placement is straight to deep midwicket. Travelled really quickly, a yard either side would have been four

gets hold of the pull shot that time. Giving himself room again, Varun tries to follow him again but bowls this too short, which means Shankar has the time to rock back and thump a pull shot over deep midwicket. Prasidh the fielder there I think but even though he leapt up the ball went over. Flat and hard.
was giving himself room and his TN team-mate follows him. Shankar has no room to free his arms so short-arm pulls it to deep square leg's left
drilled to long-on
Shankar had no clue about that one. Bowled a quicker one at 92 clicks, but one that hissed and turned so sharply from outside off that even the keeper couldn't gather properly and they get a bye
hurried on to him, and his flick goes int he air but there's no one at midwicket. Brings up fifty. Decent innings, but he needs to step it up
fumble from Dre at wide long-off gives them two. Flat bats this length ball through cover, more power than timing.

caught at cover, change of pace does the trick. Completely took the pace off that one did Prasidh, this was at 91.2 kph, full on a fourth stump line. Nabi sticks to the tried and tested method of backing away and freeing his arms, but only manages to squirt it high off a leading edge, beaten by the lack of pace.
bouncer dug in too short, goes too high above him. Wide

what a response. Lifts him over extra cover for a one bounce four. Nabi giving himself room again, hanging on the back foot, but somehow generates enough power to smack this full length delivery on a fifth stump line over extra cover. Bounced just inside the boundary

cops a painful blow on the neck. Sharp bouncer from Prasidh, and Nabi was looking to open up and pull, the ball rose higher than he expected, and he's taken his eyes off hit. Rises up above the bat and thuds into the neck. Ouch. He's going to have that looked at.
saw him making room and bowled it very wide of offstump. He had to reach for it and doesn't get bat on it. Been called a wide, bit harsh methinks
and he nails this down the ground. Full outside off, clears his front leg and thumps a drive to long-off's right
length outside off, he was opening his stance up to thrash it through off, gets a meaty enough hit but the placement isn't perfect and mid-off can stop it to his left
fuller, close to off, not enough room to free his arms, bunted through midwicket
back of a length outside off, don't think he got the pace of that right, ends up mistiming his cut to cover.
mis-times his pull to midwicket
leg stump yorker even as Nabi was looking to clear his front leg, bowled quicker too, and he misses the flick, ball rolls into the offside off his pad
giving himself room, and cuts hard, but can't beat point
went for the big swing over cow corner but got it off the toe end, rolling through midwicket to pick up a couple. Fuller ball, drifting into him.
back of a length outside off, tapped through midwicket
Pandey steps down the pitch. So, Shakib digs it short and shifts his line wide of off. Hauled away to wide long-on
round-arm rubbish from Shakib. Long-hop on the hips, picked up and duly pulled over square leg for six
back of a length, flat, quick, attacking the stumps, punched down to long-on
Pandey shows his ace early, ventures down the track. Shakib darts it well wide of off. The batsman reaches out and carves it through the covers
looped up on middle, drifting into the stumps, tapped down to long-on
tossed up slower and higher outside off, belted back to Shakib

short, wide, slashed straight into the lap of backward point. Bairstow creates more swinging room, but can't clear the infielder. Straightforward catch for Rana and that wicket exposes Sunrisers' fragile middle order
back of a length and outside off, Bairstow leans back and punches to point with an open bat-face
Bairstow is beaten for pace. 143.3ks short ball, fizzing into his body, he is late onto a pull and bottom-edges it behind to DK
Bairstow steps away outside leg, Cummins spots the early movement and digs it in, the ball bounces over middle. Bairstow wafts and misses
mighty full and wide of off, slower-ball yorker attempted by Cummins, carved down to long-off
back of a length and angling into the pads, duly deflected away to long leg, where Shakib gathers the ball
back of a length and on off stump, the length isn't there for a drive, scooped to long-off
on a length and breaks away outside off, this legbreak is chopped to short third man
whipped off the hips to long leg
shorter, and outside off, carrom ball? Slashed to point

an appeal for lbw, not given. Length ball, turning quickly into a middle-stump line, YJB aims for a slog-sweep and misses, wearing it on his thigh. But it it threatening the stumps? Spinning down leg, according to the tracker
YJB or rather Hyderabad's JB muscles it over midwicket and brings up a 32-ball fifty. Dragged down on middle, swatted away off the back foot
back of a length and outside off, opens the bat-face and guides it to point
back of a length and skidding into off, tucking up Bairstow, he almost chops it on
banged in short and outside off, 142ks, Bairstow doesn't care as he sizes it up and ramps it over the keeper's head
slower ball, full and slid down the leg side, wide called
Krishna continues to pepper his Karnataka team-mate with short stuff, pulled away to deep midwicket
Pandey backs away outside leg, Krishna follows him with a short ball, he ducks under it
dug in short, Krishna attacks the body of his Karnataka team-mate, he shifts back and pulls it away between midwicket and wide long-on
he bangs a bouncer, too high, and that's a wide
speared outside off, chopped to point off the back foot
this isn't a super ball, though. Short, attached with lots of width outside off. Bairstow goes deep in the crease and late-cuts it between point and short third man
tossed up outside off. "Super ball da" is the cry from DK behind the stumps. Driven down to long-on
Varun hits a heavy length on middle and leg, shovelled away to deep square leg
another non-turner, shortish and outside off, slashed out to sweeper cover off the back foot
fizzing through outside off at 94.2ks, Bairstow opens the bat-face and runs it to point
Cummins pounds it on a hard length, the line is just a shade outside off, Pandey stabs it only as far as short cover
short and outside off, slashed away to the off-side sweeper. Shakib cleans it up in the outfield
dug in shorter and outside off, Cummins cranks it up to 144ks, chopped away to the right of Karthik behind the stumps
short and on the hips, Pandey rides the bounce and eases it to his Karnataka team-mate Krishna at long leg
Bairstow makes swinging room this time, smears it in the air, doesn't carry to Russell at mid-off as he gathers it on the half-volley
length ball around off, right in Bairstow's swinging arc, pumped over Cummins' head
miscues this shot and it trickles into vacant square leg
whew, that is disrespectful really. Short of a length outside off, clears the front leg and pulls into the turf and past midwicket like an overaged player in an U-13 tournament
short of a length and just outside off, mistimed cut to backward point
nails it on third attempt! Another short one, just outside off. Bairstow has read the pace by now and he smokes that over midwicket with a pull
short and just outside off, looks for the pull and misses this time
steep short ball at middle stump, 133kph, looks to pull but is late on that. Top edge flies over the keeper
short of a length and angled into off stump, punched straight to extra cover off the back foot
short and low at off stump, drags a pull out to deep midwicket
short of a length at leg stump, punched to long-on
drilled over the bowler. Tossed up and he steps out early to make the pitch of this. Holds a nice shape as he connects
short of a length at the stumps, backs away and punches to long-off
short of a length and skidding low at middle stump, on the back foot to pull to deep midwicket
length and tucking him up again, a meek push towards mid-on for the single
good length and cramped again, deep in the crease as he hurriedly nudges to midwicket
short of a length at leg stump, aerial jab towards mid-on. Cramped for room there as he backs away and searches
short of a length at leg stump, nudged to deep square off the back foot
short of a length and into the thigh guard as he looks to turn that fine
good length and into the stumps, gingerly pushes this towards mid-on and then has a race against Russell because this is tight. A direct hit would have seen him struggling but Russell can't gather
tossed up slowly at off stump, leans in and drives to long-off
length at middle stump, steps out and is a tad off balance as he lofts this over mid-on
length at off stump, gets leg side of that and pokes into the covers
short of a length and into off stump, backs away and forces this to long-off
inside-out and lovely shape on that. Tossed up at middle and off, exposes the stumps and uses his reach to get to the pitch of that and lift through the line
length at middle stump, punched back to the bowler
beaten on the inside edge, nearly loses off stump, and has a chirpy Prasidh in his face immediately. Overpitched ball just outside off, cover driving line and length. He slogs and misses
short of a length, just outside off. Punched to cover point off the back foot
length outside off, looks to drive on the rise through cover. Inside edge onto pad. Gill with a diving under-arm throw this time that finds the stumps

overthrows past mid-on! Gill gets the throw woefully wrong. Short of a length outside off, dabbed towards backward point. Looks for a lot of power on the throw, ends up throwing it on the half-volley to Russel's right and he can't stop that
short and wide outside off, looks to cut, under-edge plonks into the pitch and rolls through as they steal a run from DK
good length and jagging it back in off the seam. Bairstow brings down an angled bat and gets an inside edge through midwicket
full at off stump, driven down to long-off
length and tight at the stumps, blocked on the front foot
just past short point. Short of a length, gripping and rising as he reachs out for a drive. Ends up slicing and it's short of a diving Russell
slow and at a length on off stump, solidly blocked
slow length ball at off, pushed to extra cover from the crease

chopped onto leg stump! Short of a length and skidding in with the angle, in the corridor. Saha cuts for one that would've turned more, but Shakib thrives on that. And he has a wicket first ball for his new team, against his former team
short of a length outside off, watchfully patted into the covers
just manages to keep that out. Banged in short and looks like Pandey was shaping to ramp that over slip. It keeps low and nearly slams into his mid-riff
full and just outside off, driven on the up but off the low part of the bat. Straight to mid-off

gets him with a sharp one. Prasidh has slammed this back of a length, rising with the angle across leg stump. Warner is cramped and looks to drop that into the leg side, but it's taken the outside edge and carried nicely
short and just outside off, looks for the upper cut but that's into the off side off the under-edge
good length and swung into the pads, clipped to deep square
oh this is the shot of the evening for me. Pure elegance. Tossed up and drifting away outside off, leans in and gets under that and simply helps it over the extra cover boundary
short of a length outside off, cut straight to point

dropped at point! Cummins can't hold on after throwing himself forward! Nearly. This is exactly how Harbhajan used to bowl at Narine in the powerplay - slow, loopy, turning away. Slashes, not to the pitch, thick edge put down
short of a length outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
short of a length and turning in from outside off, mistimes his cut
length and turning into leg stump, smothered out to square leg
